comparison.objective: Thread shock cord through a spring cord lock while holding its plunger open.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained spring compression plus deformable-cord insertion; no tool-mediated locking or dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Cord passes through with at least 40 mm on each side, spring grips it, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: The candidate adjusts and locks a rigid damper, then validates impact response; this record tests deformable threading through a temporarily opened passage.
